fieldOverrides.versionScope: Exact catalog npm mapping and exact published npm version with an explicit exports, main, or module runtime entry point.
positiveFacts: importable-runtime-package-surface: an exact npm version publishes an explicit importable runtime entry point
fieldOverrides.negativeAbsenceSemantics: No package mapping, publication failure, or missing entry-point property proves no package, service, sidecar, or managed adoption form.
fieldOverrides.unresolvedRemainder: Other adoption forms and the complete adoption-unit concept set remain unknown.
fieldOverrides.completenessRequirement: A complete profile value still requires closure of every applicable adoption concept; this rule supplies only a positive importable-runtime-package surface.
fieldOverrides.freshnessRequirement: Mutable registry resolution cutoff and exact immutable package version are retained.
fieldOverrides.notApplicableRule: not permitted by the field registry
fieldOverrides.rationale: An explicit exact-version runtime entry point establishes a package adoption surface; publication alone is insufficient and no other adoption form is excluded.

fieldOverrides.versionScope: The exact package name and version returned by npm's mutable latest Version endpoint at the frozen collection cutoff.
positiveFacts: A safely read exact npm Version response whose name matches the catalog mapping establishes that the retained version was addressable through the latest selector at the frozen cutoff.
fieldOverrides.negativeAbsenceSemantics: Catalog-unmapped remains deterministic not-applicable. Mapped source absence or unresolved acquisition remains unknown and never becomes not-applicable.
fieldOverrides.unresolvedRemainder: The per-version publication timestamp, package age, release recency, historical latest state, repository linkage, runtime compatibility, other distribution tags, and future availability remain unresolved by this fact.
fieldOverrides.completenessRequirement: A complete profile value still requires packageName, version, and an independently established publishedAt timestamp; the selected Version endpoint does not provide that timestamp.
fieldOverrides.freshnessRequirement: The mutable latest selector, exact returned package name/version, frozen collection cutoff, source-authority digest, and source-record digest are retained.
fieldOverrides.rationale: The bounded Version endpoint proves exact selected-version addressability but supplies no accepted publication timestamp, so the complete profile remains unknown while registry-valid direct partial evidence may realize the field.

positiveFacts: npm package format, engine range, module format, and exports declaration
fieldOverrides.negativeAbsenceSemantics: Complete optional-property omission is known; unsupported or incomplete input is unknown; catalog-unmapped is legal not-applicable.
fieldOverrides.unresolvedRemainder: None when mapped authority is complete or catalog-unmapped is proved.
fieldOverrides.freshnessRequirement: Exact version and registry cutoff retained.
fieldOverrides.rationale: The M3A completeness audit remains sound.

positiveFacts: declared-framework-peer-relation: controlled framework peer package and exact declared version range
fieldOverrides.negativeAbsenceSemantics: Missing peer declaration never proves incompatibility or no compatibility; ordinary runtime dependencies do not establish this fact.
fieldOverrides.unresolvedRemainder: Undeclared frameworks and compatibility beyond the exact declaration remain unknown.
fieldOverrides.completenessRequirement: A complete profile value requires closure of every supported framework.
fieldOverrides.notApplicableRule: not permitted by the field registry
fieldOverrides.rationale: An exact peer dependency establishes only a narrow declared framework package relation; ordinary runtime dependency presence and omission do not establish compatibility.

fieldOverrides.versionScope: Registry snapshot and catalog repository identity.
positiveFacts: matched, mismatched, or complete undeclared package repository linkage
fieldOverrides.negativeAbsenceSemantics: Only complete repository-property omission establishes undeclared; incomplete source is unknown; catalog-unmapped is legal not-applicable.
fieldOverrides.unresolvedRemainder: None under complete mapped metadata or catalog-unmapped proof.
fieldOverrides.completenessRequirement: Complete exact-package metadata and normalized identity.
fieldOverrides.rationale: The M3A completeness audit remains sound.

changeControl: Only the diagnosed npm source operation, npm-derived evidence provenance, package-publication partial semantics, and full-closure planning change. The denominator, threshold, planned-capable count, breadth, and generic partial-evidence contract remain unchanged.
